title: Preparing Students for What Comes Next: Educator and Student Perspectives on Career-Connected Learning in K–12 Schools
summary_en: The authors analyze data from three RAND survey panels to examine career-connected learning in kindergarten through grade 12 schools in academic year 2025–2026 using the perspectives of district leaders, school leaders, and high school students.
title_cn: Preparing Students for What Comes Next: Educator and Student Perspectives on Career-Connected Learning in K–12 Schools

title: Prevalence of Mental Health Discussions in Publicly Available Generative AI Conversations
summary_en: We aimed to quantify how prevalence varies under conservative vs expansive definitions of mental health by using a large public dataset of chatbot transcripts.
title_cn: Prevalence of Mental Health Discussions in Publicly Available Generative AI Conversations

title: From Occurrence to Consequence: Unraveling Urban Building Fire Risk
summary_en: In this work, we analyze more than one million fire incident reports and integrate them with community-level socioeconomic indicators, building inventories, weather conditions, and incident-specific characteristics.
title_cn: From Occurrence to Consequence: Unraveling Urban Building Fire Risk

title: The Effect of Removing Point-of-Purchase Price Discounts on College Students’ Future Tobacco Use Susceptibility Depends on Price Sensitivity
summary_en: Tobacco companies use point-of-sale discounts and coupons to sustain demand and normalize tobacco use. Removing price promotions could counteract these effects.
title_cn: The Effect of Removing Point-of-Purchase Price Discounts on College Students’ Future Tobacco Use Susceptibility Depends on Price Sensitivity

title: Tax Policy Options to Promote Employment and Mitigate Federal Revenue Impacts in the Age of AI
summary_en: AI may lower federal revenue from labor taxes. The authors of this paper propose a six-category framework of tax code reform options that could stabilize revenue and protect jobs.
title_cn: Tax Policy Options to Promote Employment and Mitigate Federal Revenue Impacts in the Age of AI
